A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Value Flows research work, with complete main text and appendices A–E. Text extraction and visual inspection support comparison of the equations, tables and figures, including relocated material.

before.justification: v2 reports original return-distribution, offline RL and offline-to-online evaluations in Section 5, plus ablations and risk-sensitive MDP experiments in Appendix D.

after.justification: v4 retains the original empirical evaluations in Section 5 and Appendix D, including benchmark results, ablations and risk-sensitive control experiments.

M1.justification: The flow objectives, uncertainty weighting and policy extraction procedures are retained. Appendix C.1 changes v_k to the target field v-bar in the weighted DCFM equation, making it consistent with the target-network procedure already explicitly described in v2.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same state-based and image-based OGBench tasks, D4RL Adroit tasks and machine-replacement MDP. Offline, offline-to-online and risk-sensitive task coverage is retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding experiments: Tables 1 and 3 retain the scalar-value and distributional baselines, Table 4 retains its offline-to-online comparators including RLPD, and Appendix D retains its comparison methods.

E3.justification: Evaluation procedures and settings are unchanged, including the 5,000-trajectory return-distribution evaluation, 60-bin histograms and 1-Wasserstein metric in Section 5.1. Appendix D protocols and the model and hyperparameter settings in Appendix E are retained.

E4.justification: Section 5.3 and Appendix D retain the regularization, confidence-weight, flow-step and rejection-sampling ablations, resource analysis, risk-sensitive control experiment, Gaussian-policy comparison and BCFM-only analysis. Relocated displays contain the same analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions retain means and standard deviations over eight seeds for state-based tasks and four for image-based tasks, with four seeds for the machine-replacement experiment. No uncertainty-reporting practice or run count changes.

E6.justification: The numerical results, plotted curves and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Value Flows remains at 87 ± 13 on puzzle-3x3-play in Table 1; relocated appendix tables and plots retain their results.

T1.justification: Proposition 2's proof changes v_k to v_{k+1} in its quadratic expansion. Lemma 6 revises the derivation to explicitly condition on both the interpolated sample and flow time and expands the t=0 argument. These are local mathematical revisions; proposition statements and claimed guarantees remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: flow-based return modeling, Bellman-consistent objectives, variance-based prioritization and the claimed average 1.3-fold performance improvement.

C2.justification: The result interpretations and limitations are retained, including explanations of regularization and Adroit policy behavior, uncertainty disentanglement limitations, and the unresolved choice of policy extraction mechanism.

D1.justification: The implementation, preprocessing, hyperparameter tables, code-access information and hardware disclosures are unchanged. Both retain the JAX implementation description, Tables 5–6 and A6000 GPU training-time information.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. The revised divergence discussion uses the same Kaplunovsky citation already present in v2; it adds no new related work.

P1.justification: Localized appendix wording and proof exposition are edited, particularly in A.3, Proposition 1 and Lemma 6, and a duplicated line in Lemma 1's proof is removed. The overall section structure and main narrative are retained.

P2.justification: Appendix equations and surrounding text are reformatted and reflowed. Table 3 moves from page 25 to 26, Figure 6 from page 26 to 25, and Figures 9–10 from page 27 to 28, with their content and numbering retained.

improvement.justification: v4 makes Lemma 6's conditioning more explicit and aligns the weighted DCFM equation with the target-field procedure already described in v2. These edits modestly improve clarity and internal consistency. The method, empirical evidence, claims and limitations remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited.
